title: Automating browser isolation: where the API surface lives across Internet & SaaS and Private Access

prose.text: Browser isolation has no API of its own: profile lookup is an Internet & SaaS operation, profiles, banners, certificates and regions are Private Access CBI configuration operations, and isolation rules are Private Access policy rules. Paths, SDK functions and Terraform resources are generated: `node scripts/kb.mjs surface /browserIsolation/profiles` and `node scripts/kb.mjs surface cbiconfig`.

prose.label: Naming.
prose.text: Python's `client.zbi` is not browser isolation: [[shared.terminology.product-names:zbi-is-business-insights]], covered in [[business-insights.api]].

prose.label: Wire behavior.
prose.text: Private Access CBI paths, list shapes and write handling are in [[zpa.api.cbi-appprotection-wire]], and the Go package layout in [[zpa.api.sdk-coverage:pra-cbi-layout]]. Internet & SaaS rule wiring of the isolate action is in [[zia.api.url-filtering-wire]].

prose.label: Two profile lists.
prose.text: {{two-profile-lists}} Which one an isolation rule's profile ID refers to, and whether the two can disagree, is open {{gap:profile-list-choice}}.

prose.label: Fields.
prose.text: Which API field carries each console setting is open {{gap:feature-field-mapping}}, and the full value sets of the copy-paste and upload-download controls are open {{gap:control-value-sets}}.
The provider documentation lists the copy-paste and upload-download values: {{tf-control-values}}
What the provider documents for individual fields: {{tf-field-descriptions}}

two-profile-lists.statement: The Private Access contract has two documented profile lists: `Get All ZPA Profiles` under the CBI configuration path, whose entries carry `cbiProfileId` and `cbiUrl`, and `Get Profiles For Customer` under the management configuration path, a paged list whose entries carry `isolationProfileId` and `isolationUrl`; both accept `showDisabled`.

tf-control-values.statement: The Terraform provider's documentation for the Private Access CBI profile lists the supported `copy_paste` values as `none` or `all`, and the supported `upload_download` values as `none`, `all` or `upstream`.

quotes: `copy_paste:` - (Optional) Enable or disable copy & paste for local computer to isolation. Supported values are: `none` or `all`
`upload_download` - (Optional) Enable or disable file transfer from local computer to isolation. Supported values are: `none`, `all`, `upstream`

tf-field-descriptions.statement: The Terraform provider's documentation for the Private Access CBI profile describes `allow_printing` as letting the user print pages rendered in the isolation browser, `restrict_keystrokes` as preventing keyboard and text input to isolated pages, `document_viewer` as viewing Microsoft Office files in isolation, `session_persistence` as saving user cookies between sessions, `watermark` as a custom watermark on isolated pages, `deep_link` as applications allowed to launch outside the isolation session, and `debug_mode` as allowing isolation sessions to start in debug mode.

quotes: `allow_printing` - (Optional) Enables the user to print web pages and documents rendered within the isolation browser.
`restrict_keystrokes:` - (Optional) Prevents keyboard and text input to isolated web pages.
`document_viewer:` - (Optional) Enable or disable to view Microsoft Office files in isolation.
`session_persistence:` - (Optional) Save user cookies between sessions.
`watermark:` - (Optional) Enable to display a custom watermark on isolated web pages.
`deep_link:` - (Optional) Enter applications that are allowed to launch outside of the Isolation session
`debug_mode`- (Optional) Enable to allow starting isolation sessions in debug mode to collect troubleshooting information.

profile-list-choice.title: Which Private Access profile list policy workflows should use, and whether the two can diverge
profile-list-choice.detail: Both lists are documented contract operations, so neither is an SDK artifact. Still open: which one's identifier an isolation rule's `zpnIsolationProfileId` expects, which one the admin console uses, and whether their contents can differ at runtime.
profile-list-choice.blocks: choosing the right lookup when writing an isolation rule

feature-field-mapping.title: Which Private Access CBI profile field carries each console setting
feature-field-mapping.detail: The Terraform provider documentation describes several Private Access profile fields in plain words (claim tf-field-descriptions), which ties them to settings. Still open: what `zgpu`, `translate` and `persistIsolationBar` do, how the region fields map to the console's Region Selection, and whether the documented `session_persistence` (user cookies saved between sessions) is the console's persistence across browser restarts.
feature-field-mapping.blocks: translating a console profile setting into an API or Terraform field

control-value-sets.title: Complete value sets of securityControls.copyPaste and uploadDownload
control-value-sets.detail: The Go struct types both as strings; the contract's examples show none and all, and the provider's documentation names upstream as an upload_download value. No source enumerates the full sets, including any directional copy-paste values.
control-value-sets.blocks: writing a profile with a directional copy-paste or file transfer setting
control-value-sets.resolution: The Terraform provider documentation enumerates the values (claim tf-control-values); the contract examples and Go struct typing are unchanged.
